faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Automation and how does it work?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp Automation uses the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API combined with AI chatbots and webhook automations to handle customer conversations, send transactional messages, and route complex queries to live agents.

faqs.question: Is WhatsApp Automation safe and compliant with Meta policies?
faqs.answer: Yes! We only use verified official Meta WhatsApp Business APIs, ensuring complete compliance with Meta terms and 100% protection against number blocking.

faqs.question: Can we integrate WhatsApp Automation with our existing CRM and eCommerce store?
faqs.answer: Yes! We integrate WhatsApp seamlessly with Shopify, WooCommerce, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Google Sheets, and custom database webhooks.

faqs.question: Do you provide end-to-end setup and ongoing support?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle everything from Meta Business verification and API setup to chatbot conversation design, workflow testing, and 24/7 technical monitoring.
